displayName: 戴夫·斯特莱德 Dave Strider
description: Unofficial Dave Strider fan-art companion from Homestuck, in a simplified opening record-shirt outfit. Original animation includes adjusting sunglasses, tapping and flipping a small record, correcting a beat, inspecting a pocket watch, rhythmic running and a short hop. The tiny turntable concept is realized as a hand-held record interaction. Independently drawn fan art; no official affiliation or authorization is claimed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
